rows.note: Use this everyday word when the inducement is someone’s motivation or driving force.

example.english: Wanting my family to have a better life is the inducement that makes me go to work every day.
example.traditional: 為咗屋企人，我每日返工嘅動力就係想畀佢哋過好啲。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 uk1 kei2 jan4 ngo5 mui5 jat6 faan1 gung1 ge3 dung6 lik6 zau6 hai6 soeng2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 gwo3 hou2 di1

rows.note: Use this as the more precise, all-purpose noun for an incentive or factor intended to bring about a result.

example.english: This tax-reduction measure became an important inducement for attracting foreign investment.
example.traditional: 呢項減稅措施成為吸引外資嘅重要誘因。
example.jyutping: ne1 hong6 gaam2 seoi3 cou3 si1 sing4 wai4 kap1 jan5 ngoi6 zi1 ge3 zung6 jiu3 jau5 jan1
